title: Incoming emails are duplicated
creator: cortexreboot
content:
Hello,

I'm using Thunderbird 160.0 (64-bit, Windows) and am signed into a Thunderbird account. In one of my IMAP accounts (using Axigen) I'm getting duplicates or multiples of the same email whenever I retrieve from the server. When I login via webmail, I only have one email. Thunderbird doesn't seem to recognise there's only one and will keep the duplicate (or triplicate) in my inbox. See the attached screenshot. I asked my email provider and they confirmed there aren't duplicates occurring server-side.

What might be causing this?

title: adding gmail account fails with "thunderbird failed to find the settings for your email account"
creator: jbclem3
content:
Using older version of Thunderbird... when I try to add a gmail account is fails with the message "thunderbird failed to find the settings for your email account". A re-test also fails, as does trying POP3. But when I try to add one of my regular (charter.net ISP) email accounts it proceeds normally and finds the account. When I try "get a new account" I get a window with the error message "sorry, we're unable to communicate with out sign up server".

So it's working with my Charter.net account but not with the gmail account. I've checked proxy settings and changed to No Proxy but that didn't help. I've triple checked my entries for my gmail address, and compared them exactly with my gmail profile..

What to do next...is it possible that this older version of Thunderbird has stored some obsolete gmail settings? If so, can they be changed?

title: Since the Outlook outage, my main hotmail account can't be accessed by Thunderbird.
creator: theodoricfuscus
content: Thunderbird stopped accessing my main hotmail account around the time of the big November outage. The other hotmail and the gmail account were not affected. This did not resolve itself and clearing the cache did not help. I then tried to delete the hotmail and add it back in. I keep getting the error message that the configuration, address, or password is wrong, but I have checked them carefully and repeatedly and they are correct. It seems as thought the program simply can't access the account. I tried another client program which is not as good, and it connected instantly. The only solution I can see is to stop using Thunderbird because 90 percent of my email uses is with this account.

title: Inability to access incoming mail server.
creator: PCexpertise
content:

"An error occurred with the POP3 mail server. Mail server pop.Juno.com responded: Service unavailable."

I have NOT changed any of my Thunderbird settings in years.

I have rebooted my laptop several times. And each time have also run Thunderbird in both regular mode and troubleshooting mode with the same resulting error message. I also always run Thunderbird in Windows administrator mode.

What are the current POP3 incoming and outgoing mail server settings for juno.com email?

Why am I receiving this error message, and what do I need to do to resolve my problem?

Thank you for any and all pertinent help in resolving this issue.
